concepts.name: 01-leon-portrait
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Linux desktop application icon concept for redegpc, Resident Evil Degeneration.
Primary request: Create ONE polished square desktop icon: a cinematic Leon S. Kennedy portrait rendered as an exquisite dark gunmetal collectible emblem. His recognizable side-swept ash brown hair, young clean-shaven face, serious expression and dark tactical high collar are the focus; chest-up tightly cropped portrait, no weapon. A simple chunky rounded-square gunmetal frame contains the portrait. Cold blue-gray light shapes his face, a small restrained dark red rim light along one side evokes survival horror. Strong readable face and hair silhouette, tactile painted metal and restrained illustrated realism, precise studio-quality edge finish. Dark background INSIDE the emblem only, true transparent alpha OUTSIDE the rounded-square silhouette. The icon fills about 88 percent of a square canvas and is front facing, centered and balanced. Designed to stay readable at 48 and 64 pixels: broad shapes, few details, no thin lines.
Constraints: one icon only, square 1024x1024 composition, transparent surrounding background, no text, no letters, no watermark, no mockup, no comparison sheet, no surrounding props, no drop shadow spread beyond the icon.

concepts.name: 02-quarantine-dossier
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Linux desktop application icon concept for redegpc, Resident Evil Degeneration, matching a survival-horror incident dossier launcher.
Primary request: Create ONE distinctive desktop icon shaped like a thick olive-gray manila incident dossier folder with a protruding index tab and a large dark crimson circular quarantine seal bearing an ivory biohazard symbol at its center. The folder itself is the icon silhouette, not an image inside a tile. Slight isometric thickness but almost frontal, broad dark backing edge, carefully worn ivory paper insert peeking above the folder. The seal must be large and immediately readable, occupying most of the folder face, its three-lobed biohazard symbol simple and bold. Sophisticated tactile illustrated 3D game launcher icon, worn paper and matte red stamped seal, moody survival horror, refined warm parchment and muted olive palette. Deliberately minimal, bold visual masses, impressive at small 48px desktop size. Centered on a square canvas, occupying 88 percent of canvas, true transparent alpha around the entire object.
Constraints: one icon only, 1024x1024 square composition, NO writing or labels or small typography, no characters, no weapons, no watermark, no presentation background, no comparison sheet, no ground plane or cast shadow outside silhouette. Clean alpha edges.

concepts.name: 03-fractured-d
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Linux desktop application icon concept for redegpc, Resident Evil Degeneration.
Primary request: Create ONE premium minimalist desktop icon, a massive sculptural capital letter D as a survival-horror emblem. The D itself forms the standalone icon silhouette, with a large open counter cut right through its center, both exterior and counter truly transparent. Broad powerful condensed D shape, brushed dark steel sides, ivory weathered enamel front surface, one bold diagonal fracture across its lower third reveals a deep crimson inner core. The crack is a controlled graphic split, no tiny splinters or floating debris. A few restrained surface scratches suggest a damaged quarantine facility. Precise beveled edges and strong tonal separation, dramatic studio lighting, refined realistic 3D icon craft. Front-on with a slight view of right edge thickness. Easily recognized at 32px, memorable silhouette, strong geometric form, almost no detail. The letter fills 86 percent of a square canvas, centered and balanced.
Text (verbatim): "D" as the sculptural object only.
Constraints: true transparent background outside D and in the D counter, one icon only, 1024x1024 square composition, no tile behind it, no additional letters or words, no symbols around it, no logo lockup, no neon glow cloud, no watermark, no mockup, no sheet, no cast shadow beyond silhouette.
